product_from_film: Perplexity is a search and answer interface that asks clarifying questions and returns sources, text, images and video.
explains_well: One travel query is narrowed by preferences, answered with sources, then extended into a visual follow-up about The Narrows.
unclear: The move from the image follow-up to a new sunset video query skips how that next request was entered.
scenario: Explore summer destinations, narrow interests to nature, then inspect a suggested place through images and video.
product_clear_basis: By 31s the preference questions lead to sources and visual results; the answer view follows at 32s.

categories.finding: Common questions → search overload → guided travel search → visual follow-up → personal exploration → brand.
Familiar search questions make the premise legible before the product is named.
The preference form shows the search approach by 23s; sources and results make the payoff clear around 31s.
Prompt text grows across samples, preference pills change selection and viewer thumbnails change active image; exact transition mechanics unverified.
The travel theme persists from the initial query through preferences, canyon images and video.
Dark search overload contrasts with a spacious white results UI and teal controls.
Large question and preference crops are readable; full answer prose and source labels are too small for full inspection in the sheets.
Voice delivery is unverified.
Music character and structure are unverified.
Effects and their sources are unverified.
categories.reason: No validated listening; waveform peaks do not identify effects.

categories.finding: Sound sync is unverified.
categories.reason: No validated listening or paired audiovisual timing.

categories.finding: Device footage, search overlays, an answer interface, image viewer and video player are visible; capture method and asset provenance are unknown.

categories.finding: The full search-to-image sequence is understandable from written prompts and visible selections without a transcript.
Input controls and follow-up text receive close framing; full-page views restore where the results live.
About twenty-six seconds follow the same travel inquiry, allowing preference selection and visual follow-up to build on each other.
Clarifying questions lead to a sourced answer and image results; the video step is shown with less input continuity.
The canyon imagery frames search as personal discovery; this is an intended emotional reading, not measured response.
A nature preference and visual follow-up visibly shape the output type; the new sunset request appears without its entry step.
Answer accuracy, source quality, live speed and personalization are not independently verified. The funding amount in the source title is not established by the inspected film.
The same travel inquiry ties preference controls to text, pictures and further exploration.
Bridge the last change of request.
